notes:
Background: Halcyon is a regional 3PL with growing ML needs — customer support chatbot + embeddings for routing and invoice search. Initial product interest started Aug 2025. POC executed Sept–Oct.

Call notes (10/27) — AE (Maya) + SE (Daniel) + Head of Data (R. Singh) + CFO (L. Morales):
- POC: 95ms p95 for chat on dedicated 4xA100 equivalent, embeddings cost ~0.6c per 1k vectors after quantization (good), but total token spend for chat expected to be large (peak 1.2M tokens/day).
- CFO: "We can't take a $50k / mo commit unless unit cost comes down or we have clear ROI."
- Head of Data: liked routing embeddings quality, asks for multi-model fallback to cheaper quantized variants during off-peak.
- Procurement: needs SOC2 + KMS + 24mo pricing schedule for dedicated nodes.

Discussions: competitor (Anthropic reseller) offered a blended committed price ~18% lower for similar latency with 6-month ramp commitment. Halcyon flagged that lowering per-token / GPU-hour is the deciding factor.

Shorthand/CRM fragments:
- "pricing doesn't pencil"
- "no CFO buy-in yet"
- "SE to model alternate commit sizes + cache plan"
- "security: want one-time audit checklist before legal signs"

Outcome as of 11/12: engagement stalled; account said they are pausing new vendor commits until Q1 budget review. Team internally shifted product lead (our champion left in late Oct).
timeline: 2025-10-21: Mid-POC check-in — performance looks good; CFO looped in
2025-11-05: Proposal sent (3 options: hosted-to-dedicated ramp, 12-mo commit, 24-mo commit)
2025-11-08: Procurement signals freeze; champion left org — last activity
use_case_summary: Primary: real-time operator chat for dispatchers (low latency P95 target <200ms) + embeddings for routing and invoice search (throughput 500-2k qps). High availability required during peak dispatch windows. Prefer VPC/private plane for auditability.
cost_analysis_summary: Why deal stalled: modeled ARR depends heavily on per-token and per-GPU-hour assumptions. Our 12-mo commit price reduced unit cost by 28% but still sat above Anthropic reseller blended price; CFO demands >35% delta vs current spend to justify capex-like commit. POC showed caching could cut peak token spend 15–20% but doesn't alter baseline long-tail usage. Dedicated node minimum (4-GPU pool) implies fixed monthly outlay too large for current budget band.
next_steps_detailed: Options to revive: 1) propose a 6-mo trial with smaller reserved baseline + usage overage pricing, 2) build a custom quantization routing plan to push non-critical traffic to cheaper model variant (SE scope), 3) offer a time-limited promotional commit (pilot price) tied to measured token reductions after caching. Action: SE (Daniel) to run 3 revised cost models and deliver by 2025-11-28; AE to schedule CFO call for budget tradeoffs after internal Q4 close.
sales_play_observations: Deal dynamics common: (a) champion churn kills momentum, (b) procurement wants longer pricing predictability but CFO won't sign large comm without clear unit economics, (c) competitor priced aggressively on committed blended token/GPU mix. Recommend building a short ROI doc showing 12-mo vs 6-mo outcomes and one-page 'cost sensitivity' chart for execs.
final_status_notes: As of update: flagged as 'stalled — price' in CRM. Re-engage window: early 2026 budget review. If no reply by 2026-02-15, mark as cold. Keep fireflies transcripts and POC metrics in account folder.
internal_owner_notes: AE: push smaller baseline pilot; avoid asking for >$40k/mo until CFO shows runway
SE: build alternative routing + quant plan; include cache estimates (15–20% token reduction)
